instruction: You begin by facing a white door in front of you. Turn to the left, and you're going to see a long hallway that features a couple of doors. Make your way along the length of this hallway until you reach the bedroom door at the very end. Now, once you reach this door, turn directly around and you're going to see a flight of stairs along with another hallway. So, make your way to the banister of the flight of stairs and then walk along the length of the hallway, which will have a carpet on the floor and some pictures displayed along the wall on the left. Now, once you reach the end of the hallway, there is a doorway on the right, so turn into this room. You will see a room that features yellow walls,a bed on the right side and a cabin-style window directly ahead with a seating area right below. Walk all the way up to this window and you are done.
